name: Update MS Learn Dates

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  update-dependencies:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'

      - name: Install Bicep CLI
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y bicep-cli

      - name: Build Bicep templates
        run: bicep build --build-mode latest

      - name: Run tests

      - name: Package toolkit
        run: |
          .\Package-Toolkit.ps1

      - name: Copy metadata files
        run: |
          # Add your file copying logic here
          echo "Copying metadata files..."
          # Example: Copy-Item -Path "./apps/*/metadata.bicep" -Destination "./release"

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update dependencies and add metadata files"
          git push origin main
